_doc: AAC Factory user preferences. Edit freely — generators, the improvement loop, and the future S6 compiler read this. Per-node card values always win over these defaults.

_auth_mode_options: oauth-cli (claude -p via your Claude login, no API key)

local._doc: Set allow_local_models true and list models to add them to the improvement ladder (cost_rank 0 = cheapest). The improver will trial them like any challenger; adoption still requires the holdout pass.
